== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}} 
Sarah was born about 1843, in Virginia. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-2573|Joseph Glasgow]] and [[Gilbert-25488|Lucy Gilbert]].

Records have not been found after the 1866 cohabiting record. 

=== Slave Owner ===
George P. Tayloe - Roanoke County, Virginia (likely [[Tayloe-72|George Plater Tayloe]])<ref>Roanoke County (Va.)
